Description: Apply power-up/reset and verify processor, bus, memories and peripherals enter defined reset states.
Test_Scenario: Assert/deassert reset; inspect reset values and ensure no unknown control state.
C_Programming_Part: C: Execute startup code; read documented reset/status registers where available.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive reset; check reset polarity, duration, reset values and X/Z-free control signals.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External: clk, reset. Internal: reset distribution to CPU, bus and IPs.
Signal_List: Reset, clk, reset_n/reset (actual polarity TBD), peripheral reset signals (TBD)
Expected_Result: All blocks enter documented reset state; no unintended bus transaction.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: All reset checks pass; reset polarity and exact reset values confirmed from RTL/register spec.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Reset polarity and reset values are not specified in the architecture document.

Description: Verify the SoC operates with the configured clock and that synchronous blocks respond on active clock edges.
Test_Scenario: Run clock at the configured frequency; observe state progression.
C_Programming_Part: C: Not directly measurable by ordinary C; optionally read a timer/heartbeat register.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Generate clock; check state and interface activity only on specified edges.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Clock source enters SoC from testbench/board.
Signal_List: clk
Expected_Result: Synchronous logic progresses without X propagation or unexpected edge behavior.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Clock-driven checks pass at configured frequency.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Clock frequency is implementation-specific and must be supplied.

Description: Verify processor instruction fetches from the instruction memory region.
Test_Scenario: Load a known program and execute it; verify expected program behavior.
C_Programming_Part: C: Run a small instruction sequence and report a signature through UART or a result register.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Preload instruction memory; monitor fetch address/data and compare with reference contents.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU instruction-fetch interface ↔ interconnect ↔ instruction memory.
Signal_List: Instruction address, instruction data, fetch request/response, ready/valid or bus equivalents (TBD)
Expected_Result: Correct instructions are returned for valid addresses and program executes as expected.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Fetched words match preload image; software signature matches expected value.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Exact VeeR EL2 instruction interface and bus signals must be taken from supplied RTL.

Description: Verify lowest/highest valid instruction-memory addresses and behavior outside the mapped region.
Test_Scenario: Access first and last valid word; access unmapped address immediately beyond region.
C_Programming_Part: C: Execute from valid region; attempt controlled unmapped access only if exception handling is defined.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Issue boundary reads and check selected slave and bus error response.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ instruction memory; unmapped access to interconnect.
Signal_List: Address, slave-select, read-data, ready/response/error (TBD)
Expected_Result: Valid addresses access instruction memory; unmapped address does not select a valid slave and returns defined error behavior.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No address aliasing; invalid access returns specified error.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: PDF table lists instruction memory 0x0000_0000–0x0000_7FFF (32 KB); resolve against final RTL map.

Description: Verify data memory stores and returns values correctly.
Test_Scenario: Write/read walking ones, zeros, alternating patterns and pseudorandom words.
C_Programming_Part: C: Write patterns to memory, read back and compare.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive or observe bus transactions; scoreboard expected memory contents.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ data memory.
Signal_List: Address, write data, read data, write enable, byte enables, ready/response (TBD)
Expected_Result: Read data equals last legal write for each location and byte lane.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: All tested locations/patterns read back correctly.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Exact data-memory bus interface and byte-enable behavior are RTL-dependent.

Description: Verify data-memory address boundaries and ensure no overlap with other regions.
Test_Scenario: Test first/last valid word, adjacent unmapped addresses and distinct locations.
C_Programming_Part: C: Boundary read/write tests where software can safely access them.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Sweep boundary addresses; verify decode and detect unintended aliasing.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ data memory and address decoder.
Signal_List: Address, chip-select/slave-select, write/read controls, response (TBD)
Expected_Result: Only addresses in the assigned region select data memory.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No overlap, aliasing or incorrect slave selection.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: PDF memory map currently lists 0x0001_0000–0x0001_7FFF (32 KB); confirm final map.

Description: Verify each mapped address selects exactly one intended slave.
Test_Scenario: Access each memory/peripheral base and representative offsets.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read/write each peripheral's documented registers.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Monitor address decode and one-hot slave selection for each transaction.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: VeeR EL2 master ↔ system interconnect ↔ all slaves.
Signal_List: HADDR/HWRITE/HWDATA/HRDATA/HREADY/HRESP if AHB-Lite is confirmed; otherwise actual bus signals.
Expected_Result: Correct slave is selected for each mapped address; no multiple selections.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: All mapped addresses route to the intended target exactly once.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Architecture says exact protocol is pending; AHB-Lite is only a reference configuration.

Description: Verify read request, slave response and completion behavior.
Test_Scenario: Read memory and peripheral registers; include wait states if supported.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read registers and compare with expected/reset values.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Create read sequences; check address/control stability and returned data/response.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ selected slave.
Signal_List: Address, read control, read data, ready/valid, response/error (TBD)
Expected_Result: Read completes and correct data returns to the processor.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Data and completion timing match the implemented protocol.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Exact handshake and timing must be confirmed from RTL.

Description: Verify write request, routing, data acceptance and completion.
Test_Scenario: Write memory and writable peripheral registers.
C_Programming_Part: C: Write known values and read back where register semantics allow.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Create write sequences; check selected slave, data, byte enables and response.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ selected slave.
Signal_List: Address, write control, write data, byte strobe, ready/response (TBD)
Expected_Result: Only the selected target is updated and transaction completes correctly.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Written value/side effect matches specification.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Register access types and byte lanes need register specification.

Description: Verify invalid or unmapped address accesses do not select a valid peripheral.
Test_Scenario: Issue read and write to holes in the address map.
C_Programming_Part: C: Trigger access only if the software trap/exception handler is implemented; record exception/error.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive unmapped transactions and check no slave select and defined error response.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect address decoder.
Signal_List: Address, slave selects, bus response/error, ready (TBD)
Expected_Result: No valid slave is selected; appropriate bus error response is generated.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Error is observable and no valid peripheral state changes.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Architecture explicitly requires an appropriate error response; exact encoding TBD.

Description: Verify UART memory-mapped control/status/data register access.
Test_Scenario: Read status, configure baud/control, write transmit data and read receive data if supported.
C_Programming_Part: C: Configure UART and access documented registers.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Bus-functional access to UART registers; compare register behavior.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ UART register interface.
Signal_List: Bus address/data/control; UART TX, RX; TX_READY, RX_VALID, BUSY; TX_DATA, RX_DATA
Expected_Result: Register accesses work and status reflects UART operation.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Register values and side effects match UART register specification.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Register offsets/bit definitions and baud clock formula are not in PDF.

Description: Verify serial output of processor-provided data.
Test_Scenario: Transmit single byte, multiple bytes, 0x00, 0xFF, alternating and back-to-back bytes.
C_Programming_Part: C: Send known string/byte sequence and optionally print test signature.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Monitor TX; decode serial frames and compare data, start/stop bits and baud timing.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Internal: CPU/bus ↔ UART. External: UART TX pin → receiver/testbench.

Expected_Result: Correct serial frames are transmitted in order at configured baud rate.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Decoded bytes and frame timing match expected values.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: UART frame format, parity and stop-bit settings must be confirmed.

Description: Verify UART receives serial data and exposes it to processor.
Test_Scenario: Drive valid serial frames and read received data/status.
C_Programming_Part: C: Poll or interrupt on RX_VALID; read RX_DATA.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive RX pin with valid frames; check received byte and status.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Internal: UART ↔ bus/CPU. External: testbench/serial source → UART RX.
Signal_List: RX, RX_DATA, RX_VALID, BUSY, clk, reset
Expected_Result: Received byte is captured and reported correctly.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: RX_DATA matches transmitted stimulus and RX_VALID behavior is correct.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: RX error handling and register semantics need RTL/spec confirmation.

Description: Verify UART behavior under continuous traffic and malformed frames if supported.
Test_Scenario: Send consecutive frames; inject framing/parity errors if implemented.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read status/error registers and count received bytes.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive minimum-gap frames and malformed frames; check documented error flags.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: UART RX/TX and register interface.
Signal_List: RX, TX, RX_VALID, TX_READY, BUSY, error flags (TBD)
Expected_Result: No data loss under supported throughput; errors are flagged as specified.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Byte ordering, readiness and error indications match specification.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Error detection features are not explicitly specified in architecture.

Description: Verify timer enable, count progression, compare and match status.
Test_Scenario: Program compare value; enable timer; observe count and match.
C_Programming_Part: C: Configure timer, poll RUNNING/MATCH and measure expected expiration in timer ticks.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Access timer registers; check count progression and compare event.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ Timer.
Signal_List: Bus signals; ENABLE, RESET, COMPARE, counter value, RUNNING, MATCH
Expected_Result: Counter progresses while enabled and MATCH asserts at the programmed condition.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Count and match timing agree with timer specification.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Counter width, prescaler and compare semantics are not specified.

Description: Verify timer stops, resets and responds to new compare values.
Test_Scenario: Disable during count; reset; program a new compare value.
C_Programming_Part: C: Exercise enable/disable/reset/reprogram sequence and read status.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Check count hold/reset and match deassertion/retrigger behavior.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ Timer.
Signal_List: ENABLE, RESET, COMPARE, counter value, RUNNING, MATCH
Expected_Result: Timer follows defined control semantics without stale match events.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Observed count/status matches expected model.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Exact reset and match-clearing semantics need RTL/register specification.

Description: Verify GPIO direction configuration and output data.
Test_Scenario: Configure pins as outputs; write patterns 0x00, all-ones and alternating patterns.
C_Programming_Part: C: Configure direction and write/read output register.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Monitor GPIO output pins and compare to programmed values.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Internal: CPU/bus ↔ GPIO. External: GPIO_OUTPUT pins → board/testbench loads.
Signal_List: GPIO_OUTPUT, direction configuration, bus write signals
Expected_Result: Output pins reflect programmed values for pins configured as outputs.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: All tested patterns match; input-configured pins behave per spec.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Pin count, register layout and electrical constraints are implementation-specific.

Description: Verify external input values are sampled and readable.
Test_Scenario: Drive low/high and changing patterns on input pins.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read GPIO input register and compare with applied pattern.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive GPIO_INPUT and check bus-visible input value and any synchronization behavior.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External: testbench/board → GPIO_INPUT. Internal: GPIO ↔ bus/CPU.
Signal_List: GPIO_INPUT, bus read data, clk, reset
Expected_Result: Processor reads the applied input state according to sampling/synchronization rules.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Readback matches stable driven inputs.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Input synchronizers/debounce are not specified in PDF.

Description: Verify FIFO stores packet words and returns them in order.
Test_Scenario: Write a short sequence then read it back; test one entry and several entries.
C_Programming_Part: C: Program FIFO control/data registers if CPU-side FIFO access is supported; verify status/data.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive packet input handshake; collect output handshake; scoreboard ordering.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External: packet source → FIFO input. Internal: FIFO ↔ bus/CPU register interface and FIFO output ↔ CRC input.
Signal_List: DATA_IN, VALID_IN, READY_IN, DATA_OUT, VALID_OUT, READY_OUT, ENABLE, RESET, READ, WRITE
Expected_Result: No loss, duplication or reordering; data out equals data in.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Scoreboard reports exact sequence match.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: PDF names packet stream signals; exact handshake polarity/timing must be verified in RTL.

Description: Verify EMPTY and FULL status at boundary occupancy levels.
Test_Scenario: Reset empty; write until full; read until empty; check each transition.
C_Programming_Part: C: Poll FIFO status register at empty/full boundaries.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Fill/drain FIFO and assert status against reference occupancy model.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: FIFO internal state/status and memory-mapped status register.
Signal_List: EMPTY, FULL, VALID_IN, READY_IN, VALID_OUT, READY_OUT, RESET
Expected_Result: EMPTY/FULL assert and deassert at correct occupancy boundaries.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Flags match reference occupancy at every accepted transfer.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: FIFO depth and status latency must be read from RTL/configuration.

Description: Verify overflow detection when writes are attempted while FIFO cannot accept data.
Test_Scenario: Fill FIFO and continue presenting input according to interface protocol.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read overflow status/counter after overflow event.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Apply over-capacity traffic; check overflow indication and data integrity of retained entries.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External packet source → FIFO; internal FIFO status/counter event path.
Signal_List: VALID_IN, READY_IN, FULL, OVERFLOW, FIFO_OVERFLOW, clk, reset
Expected_Result: Overflow is indicated; FIFO does not silently corrupt stored data.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Overflow flag/event occurs as specified; retained data follows defined policy.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Drop/overwrite/backpressure policy is not defined in architecture; confirm RTL.

Description: Verify producer respects READY_IN and FIFO handles sustained traffic.
Test_Scenario: Hold VALID_IN while READY_IN is low; resume when ready.
C_Programming_Part: C: Usually not directly driven by C if packet source is testbench; read resulting status/counters.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive valid/ready handshake; check data stability while stalled and accepted-transfer accounting.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External packet source ↔ FIFO packet input.
Signal_List: DATA_IN, VALID_IN, READY_IN, FULL
Expected_Result: No transfer occurs without valid/ready acceptance; data is not lost during backpressure.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Accepted beats exactly match expected sequence.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Handshake convention must be confirmed from RTL.

Description: Verify CRC calculation and comparison for a valid packet.
Test_Scenario: Send packet with independently calculated expected CRC.
C_Programming_Part: C: Configure CRC polynomial/initial value and start operation; read result/status.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Drive DATA_IN/DATA_VALID; compare calculated CRC and PASS/VALID status with reference CRC model.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External stimulus or internal FIFO output → CRC input; CRC register interface ↔ bus/CPU.
Signal_List: DATA_IN, DATA_VALID, RESET, START, ENABLE, BUSY, VALID, PASS, ERROR, calculated CRC
Expected_Result: Valid packet produces expected CRC and PASS indication.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Calculated CRC equals reference; PASS asserted; ERROR deasserted.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Polynomial, reflection, final XOR, bit/byte order and CRC width are not specified.

Description: Verify CRC checker detects corrupted data.
Test_Scenario: Flip one or more payload bits without updating expected CRC.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read CRC status/result and record error.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Inject controlled corruption and compare expected ERROR/PASS behavior.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Packet stream → CRC checker; status/result → bus/CPU.
Signal_List: DATA_IN, DATA_VALID, START, BUSY, VALID, PASS, ERROR, CRC result
Expected_Result: Corrupted packet is identified as CRC failure.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: ERROR asserted or PASS deasserted according to defined semantics.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Exact error signaling and CRC framing must be specified.

Description: Verify polynomial/initial CRC configuration and reset/start behavior.
Test_Scenario: Test reset while idle; configure supported polynomials/initial values; start calculation.
C_Programming_Part: C: Program configuration registers and verify documented readback/status.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Apply reset/config/start sequences; compare with reference model for each supported configuration.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/interconnect ↔ CRC registers and CRC internal datapath.
Signal_List: RESET, START, ENABLE, polynomial, initial CRC, BUSY, VALID, PASS, ERROR
Expected_Result: Configuration affects CRC result as specified; reset clears operation/status appropriately.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Reference model matches for all supported configurations.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Supported polynomial set and register encoding are not given in PDF.

Description: Verify packet received and processed counters increment on events.
Test_Scenario: Generate known number of receive/process events.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read packet statistics registers and compare with expected counts.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Pulse/drive PACKET_RECEIVED and PACKET_PROCESSED events; compare counter model.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Packet FIFO/packet path event sources ↔ Packet Counter; counter registers ↔ bus/CPU.
Signal_List: PACKET_RECEIVED, PACKET_PROCESSED, ENABLE, RESET, CLEAR, counter values
Expected_Result: Counters increment exactly according to accepted events while enabled.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Read counters equal event totals.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Counter widths, event pulse protocol and overflow behavior need RTL/spec.

Description: Verify CRC error and FIFO overflow statistics.
Test_Scenario: Inject CRC failures and FIFO overflow events in controlled quantities.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read CRC error and FIFO overflow counter registers.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Generate CRC_ERROR and FIFO_OVERFLOW events and compare counts.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CRC checker/FIFO status event outputs → Packet Counter.
Signal_List: CRC_ERROR, FIFO_OVERFLOW, ENABLE, RESET, CLEAR, error counter values
Expected_Result: Error counters reflect generated error events correctly.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Counts match event totals with no false increments.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Exact event connection and edge/pulse semantics must be confirmed.

Description: Verify counter control functions.
Test_Scenario: Increment counters; disable; clear; reset; check values and event gating.
C_Programming_Part: C: Write control register and read counters/status.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Apply control sequences and check counter state against reference model.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: CPU/bus ↔ Packet Counter and event inputs.
Signal_List: ENABLE, RESET, CLEAR, PACKET_RECEIVED, PACKET_PROCESSED, CRC_ERROR, FIFO_OVERFLOW
Expected_Result: Counter follows documented clear, reset and enable semantics.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No increment while disabled if specified; clear/reset values are correct.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Priority when clear and event coincide is not specified.

Description: Verify complete packet path from source through FIFO and CRC to CPU-visible status and UART reporting.
Test_Scenario: Send one or multiple valid packets and inspect all results.
C_Programming_Part: C: Initialize IPs, configure CRC, poll completion/statistics, report result through UART.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Generate packet stream; monitor FIFO/CRC/counter events; scoreboard end-to-end result.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External packet source → FIFO; FIFO → CRC; event paths → counter; CPU/bus → UART TX external.
Signal_List: Packet stream signals, CRC status, counter events, bus signals, UART TX
Expected_Result: Valid packets are buffered, checked, counted and reported correctly.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Packet data/order, CRC PASS, counters and UART report all match expected values.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: System-level test depends on final packet format, register map and software ABI.

Description: Verify corrupted packet is detected and statistics/reporting are updated.
Test_Scenario: Send a packet with corrupted payload or CRC.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read CRC result and error counters; send report over UART.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Inject corruption; check CRC ERROR, counter increment and CPU-visible status.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External packet source; internal FIFO/CRC/counter; external UART TX.
Signal_List: DATA_IN, DATA_VALID, CRC_ERROR, counter values, UART TX
Expected_Result: Corruption is detected and reported; error counter increments.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: CRC failure, counter and UART output agree with injected fault.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Expected packet error policy and report format must be defined.

Description: Verify back-to-back packet handling and sustained traffic.
Test_Scenario: Send multiple packets with varied lengths and legal gaps.
C_Programming_Part: C: Configure/monitor packet processing and compare aggregate statistics.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Randomize packet lengths/gaps; scoreboard packet boundaries, ordering and results.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: Packet source ↔ FIFO ↔ CRC; event paths ↔ counter; CPU reads status.
Signal_List: VALID_IN, READY_IN, DATA_IN, DATA_OUT, VALID_OUT, READY_OUT, CRC status, event signals
Expected_Result: All supported packets are processed without loss or miscount.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Received/processed/error counts and packet results match reference.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Maximum packet size, packet boundary marker and throughput target are unspecified.

Description: Verify system-level response when packet arrival exceeds FIFO capacity.
Test_Scenario: Overdrive packet source to create overflow; continue/stop according to policy.
C_Programming_Part: C: Read overflow status/counter and report through UART.
SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Create controlled overflow; check FIFO flag, counter event and software-visible status.
Internal_or_External_Interface_Details: External packet source → FIFO; FIFO overflow event → counter; CPU/bus → UART.
Signal_List: VALID_IN, READY_IN, FULL, OVERFLOW, FIFO_OVERFLOW, counter values, UART TX
Expected_Result: Overflow is detected, counted and reported without unrelated corruption.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: Overflow count and UART report match injected overflow events.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Overflow recovery and dropped-packet policy require design definition.

Description: Verify processor register accesses while packet stream is active.
Test_Scenario: Run packet source while CPU reads status/counters and accesses peripherals.

SystemVerilog_Part: SV: Concurrent packet stimulus and bus transactions; check no deadlock or cross-interface corruption.

Expected_Result: CPU transactions complete while packet pipeline continues correctly.
Pass_Fail_Criteria: No deadlock, lost bus response, corrupted packet or incorrect count.
Assumptions_or_Open_Items: Arbitration and concurrency behavior depend on actual interconnect implementation.

Description: Verify optional interrupts for FIFO, counter, CRC, UART, timer and GPIO only if included.
Test_Scenario: Enable source, trigger event, check interrupt and clear/servicing behavior.

Expected_Result: Interrupt is generated and cleared according to implementation.
